rows: The surprise is for the people watching. Not for the person catching me.
Brawling is a bit of a laugh, honestly. I still like to know where everybody is.
Risk? I do love a bit of risk. I just like to know where the mats are first.
Taking it slow is not my natural speed, but I can do it if you ask nicely.
The people are the best bit of my week. I want them to see something they did not expect, and to know I meant it.
Quick one: I am ready, and I am nervous, and both things are true.
I am not the headline, but I have been practising the bits that matter.
Look at this stance, I practised it. Relaxed on the outside, careful on the inside.
You are big on technique. Show me one thing you are sure of, and then I will show you mine.
Strikes are fine. I just want to know they are going to stop where I expect them to.
Risk, to me, is fun when it has been thought about. Have you thought about yours?
A stall is not much of a surprise. I would rather you tried something.
The people deserve a bit of joy, and some honest preparation. I want to give them both.
You say I am reckless. I am not. I just do not like being predictable.
You are proud of your {strength}. Good, I am glad. I want to see it working. Right, then, honest. I am glad. I want to see it working tonight.
I have been looking at your {strength}, and I think there is room for a little surprise in it.
Steady, honestly impressive. Lovely. I will try to keep you laughing, which is harder than it sounds.
Agreed, for now, promise. We both want the same thing from the evening.
I could make a joke about that. I will, but I will also mean it.
One fall, the surprise can wait. Keep me down, and I will be very impressed and a bit embarrassed.
On the mat I will be quick and careful, and you will have to keep up.
Grounded or standing, I am still here, and I am still prepared.
Look at me, the fun starts now. I want to see what you have got before I do anything daft.
That was a fine answer, truly. You have made me think, which is annoying.
You have not replied yet, and I wait. I will wait, but I am getting a bit impatient.
Agreed, for now, promise. I will take that as a sensible point.
That is a fair point, I will take it kindly. We will see at the bell.
I will give this match everything I have, and I will be careful while I do it.
My approach is playful and prepared. You will see both on the night.
Whatever happens, I want you to know I took it seriously.
I am not done with the fun yet. There is one more thing I have been practising.
I have one more surprise for you, and I promise it is a safe one. You will see when the bell rings.
Well, that was a leap I shouldn't have made. I haven't got a proper example to back it up.
I like a surprise, not an invented story about you. Fair question; I can't establish that charge.
Fair enough! Let's leave that bit behind and find out what surprises the match brings.
Thank you for clearing that up. Now we can have some fun without that hanging over us.
